title: SEED-L05 read-back summary total outstanding (derive-don't-store)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the SEED-L05 loan-detail summary read-back, the zero-interest loan of the seeded population (annualInterestRate 0.00). request.summary.principal_outstanding_minor=4185009 is the capture summary's "principalOutstanding":41850.090000 in minor units; the interest, fee and penalty buckets are the empty "interestOutstanding":0.000000, "feeChargesOutstanding":0.000000 and "penaltyChargesOutstanding":0.000000. expect.summary_total_minor=4185009 is the capture summary's "totalOutstanding":41850.090000, the total Fineract derived from those buckets (total_outstanding_derived). The four buckets are observed, nothing was computed: the whole total lives in the principal bucket. The registered wrong implementation loan-wrong-summary-drops-principal derives total_outstanding from the interest, fee and penalty buckets only and drops the principal bucket as if the outstanding principal were repaid, so it computes 0 here, 4185009 short of the oracle's 4185009, and the vector goes red. It is the isolating counterpart of the interest-bearing vectors: on this principal-only loan the complementary wrong implementation loan-wrong-summary-interest-not-outstanding (which reads the interest bucket as recovered) is invisible, because the capture carries no interest to drop. Nothing was computed by this promotion.

provenance.note: request.summary buckets and expect.summary_total_minor are transcribed from the "summary" block of the committed capture loan-5-detail-raw.json; capture_case_id names the externalId of the observed loan.
